content.ascii:
[B] Diagram
=============================================================
[Diagram]
  diagramId   stable service identity
  revisionId  issued service revision
  id          local scene content key
  revision    nonnegative integer
    |
    +-- content: DiagramContent
    |     revisionId = id:revision
    |     ascii + asciiSha256
    |     structure
    |       +-- diagram
    |       '-- tree: parserVersion + rootIds + nodes[id]
    |             ascii-tree-1 / ascii-tree-2
    |             label, line, branchColumn,
    |             startColumn, endColumn,
    |             parentId?, childIds, foldRanges
    |
[DiagramSourceContext]
    | contentHash = hash(content.ascii)
    | binding?: sourceId + repositoryIdentity
    |           corpus + domainProfileId
    | mappings[] -- entityId + sourceRangeIndex --+
    | evidence[entityId].sourceRanges[] <---------+
    |   range: id, path, startLine, endLine, originalLines
    |
    '-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]  (on Diagram)
             |
[Validation and queries]
  buildDiagramContent --> canonical parse + hash
  printable ASCII + LF; 1-20000 characters
  validateDiagram --> identities / canonical content
    binding / jumps / local mappings / evidence joins
  diagramSource --> entries / forSelection / search
  visibleContentLines --> exclude tree fold ranges
    unknown collapsed ID --> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
Sources: diagram.ts; diagramContent.ts
